notes.title: Lone Planet, doing its best
notes.content:
Will this message even be displayed somewhere? If you are a loner out there reading this, I appreciate it.

I am doing what I can, the future is never certain. The game should come out at some point this year. There is a free demo already on the store page, you can try that if you want.

Stay safe, and see you soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42116671/05a969a64afe41be4e99b3149cde476da0e66524.png[/img]

notes.title: Introducing: Lone Planet
notes.content:
Welcome to Lone Planet: start a journey on your lonely planet to discover the birth and fate of the universe. While in search of the meaning of life, live this light adventure playing with unusual physics, in a puzzle platform manner.

The game offers (but is not limited to):
[list]
[*] Moments of contemplation
[*] (Bad) humor
[*] Deep lore
[*] Easy platform sections
[*] Slightly harder platform sections
[*] Science references
[/list]

Everything presented to you through: colorful vector art.

[b]Try the demo now![/b]
